question.problem:
From top to bottom, what are the missing expressions in the following polynomial division problem?

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,\boxed{} \\  & x-6\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,6{x}^{2}+\phantom{0}0x-\phantom{00}4} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{6{x}^{2}-36x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\boxed{} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{36x-216}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,212\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
Notice that the dividend is missing the $x$-term. So, we write it using a zero coefficient, as follows: 

$$
6{x}^{2}+0x-4
$$

Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,6x+36 \\  & x-6\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,6{x}^{2}+\phantom{0}0x-\phantom{00}4} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{6{x}^{2}-36x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,36x-4 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{36x-216}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,212\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing expressions are

$\,$ $6x+36\,$ and $\,36x-4.$
